init.title: PulsePoint options
init.description: Filter incidents, tune polling, set up watched addresses, and choose how long cleared incidents linger on the map. These settings apply to this agency only.

data.incident_types: Only include these incident types (leave empty for all)
data.watched_addresses: Watched addresses (YAML list; each item: name, address, latitude, longitude)

data_description.closed_ttl: How long to keep a cleared incident's map pin on the map before removing it. Set to 0 to remove pins immediately when the incident clears. Applies to this agency only.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Force an immediate poll of all configured PulsePoint agencies.
